prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most kinds of change; only seven kinds (home wait_info, finish new_screen, choose_path copy, adoption notification, sign_in incentive, sign_in hint, and adoption layout) have at least 2 tests.
'home, wait_info' is helpful, supported by three winning tests out of five (+2.7% average after noise correction).
'finish, new_screen' is helpful overall, with two winning tests out of four (+2.2% average after noise correction).
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, notification', 'sign_in, incentive', 'sign_in, hint', and 'adoption, layout', as all tests for these kinds resulted in no clear effect.
Results for 'choose_path, copy' remain inconsistent across tests (one lost: worse, one won), so no clear pattern has been established.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic for unhelpful changes, but underpredicted gains on several major winning tests.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Full Bleed Desktop Launch Overview Redesign: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a full bleed layout featuring an interactive desktop visibility and interaction checklist. (why: The finish step takes a mean duration of 5815s and support receives multiple issues regarding pet control and desktop interaction.)
1: [sign_in, layout] Card Layout Account Credentials Focus: Transforms the sign-in screen into a structured card layout featuring clear visual feedback and a friendly mascot graphic. (why: Sign-in conversion drops to 72.9% with a high mean time of 567s, and technical sign-in screen stalls were reported in support mail.)
2: [adoption, notification] Photo Processing Audio Notification Badge: Adds an active processing audio cue and notification status banner on the photo upload screen to reassure users while custom pets generate. (why: Custom pet generation causes user confusion and drop-offs during adoption (60.9% conversion rate), with support emails reporting generation failures.)
3: [choose_path, hint] App Intro Story Interactive Companion Hint: Adds a hint banner to the app story intro screen clarifying that desktop pets live conveniently in the system tray. (why: The choose_path step has a huge mean time (514s). Providing immediate clarity on how desktop pets function sets better expectations early.)

scores.note: Both funnel duration and support tickets highlight finish friction, but redesigns consistently underperform across all steps.
Strong evidence from drop-off and support mail, but layout changes have shown negative or flat results in past tests.
Target step loses the most users and has support complaints, but adoption notification tests averaged -2.9% across 2 tests.
Low cost banner; choose_path hint gained +2.8% in its single previous test, though evidence from support mail is lacking.
